static_traits.name: Chen Yaning
static_traits.social_status: 与同学的关系因Self-doubt影响小组活动而变得紧张；虽有朋友与同学可交流，但对分享失败与Self-doubt感到not适
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 配合度高，态度积极；自述紧张但愿意沟通；表达清晰并能进行自我Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: 在上月的日语考试not及格后，我一直觉得自己是个失败者，认为自己很笨。
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent feelings of failure and doubts about academic ability prompted me to seek counseling to deal with these problems.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次考试失败，就说明I am not smart enough、not适合这门课程
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍学习并向同学寻求帮助以证明自己能够胜任

special_situations.event: 在学习日语时每当遇到难点或困难
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在学习中遇到困难，就证明我have not能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pressures herself and engages in self-criticism, forcing herself to study harder
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这再次证明I am not smart enough

special_situations.event: Thinks about having had successes in homework or class participation that coexist with exam failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有正式考试才是能力的真实衡量，其他成功not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以考试成绩作为唯一标准，忽略其他积极表现
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 作业做得好not重要，这次考试才说明我not行

special_situations.event: 考试前因“必须表现好”而承受高压力
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我必须考好、应该做得更好，否则就是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 设定完美化标准、对自己严格要求
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我本来就应该考得更好

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可、被视为有能力
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为愚蠢或失败，担心自我价值被negate
defense_goal: 通过自我苛责与高标准维持掌控感
避免向他人暴露脆弱以减少羞耻

object_relations.self_representation: not够聪明、随时可能失败的Student
object_relations.object_representation: 严格、带有评判的权威（考试/课程）
可能失望或疏离的同伴

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当朋友或同学成为潜在的倾诉对象、被邀请讨论失败感与Self-doubt时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心暴露脆弱会被看轻或被评判为“愚蠢”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 避免深入表达情绪，use简短、含糊的回答，Displacement话题至学业细节，保持克制的语气。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当面对正式考试或被要求以分数评估能力时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing exams as the sole and decisive evaluator, thereby avoiding facing shame and fear
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes words such as 'standards, measurement, objectivity', discusses exam difficulty in an analytical tone, avoiding talking about shame and fear.

manifestations: 将一次考试当作自我价值的唯一衡量
在日语学习遇到困难时体验到“我not值得”
negate作业与课堂参与中的成功体验
虽有朋友与同学可交流，但not愿讨论失败与Self-doubt
outcomes: 支持系统not yet被有效利用

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“我应该做得更好”的自我要求
将考试成绩视为唯一权威标准

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Self-denial（如“I am a failure/我很笨”）
与朋友谈及感受时过于谨慎甚至回避

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出的行为冲动，或放弃向外寻求do not人为其做某事，转而对自己做，与“冲动”对应。
manifestations: not向朋友寻求情感支持，转而加倍学习与自我批评

positive_force: 愿意向同学寻求帮助并加倍学习（具备行动倾向）
愿意尝试认知重构与现实检验（态度积极）
在作业或课堂参与中曾有Good表现（可作为能力证据）
具备一定的社会支持资源（朋友和同学）
negative_force: 过度概括与自我标签，以一次失败定义自身
negate积极经验、过度关注考试结果
外部验证依赖显著，自我价值高度依赖分数
Repression情绪并回避与支持系统交流
高压力与完美化自我要求

target_behavior.behavior: 在学习日语时出现的负性自我对话与自我标签（如“我很笨”“I am a failure”）
antecedent: 收到日语考试not及格的结果
在学习中遇到难点或错误
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizes a single failure and binds self-worth to the exam score (overgeneralization, external validation)
target_behavior.function: 逃避羞耻与not确定感，通过自我批评试图获得控制或动力
target_behavior.consequence: 日语课程表现下降；与同学Relationship tension；其他科目与课外活动的Reduced motivation

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与朋友或同学讨论失败感与Self-doubt
antecedent: 被他人邀请或有机会分享感受时
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被评判为愚蠢或被看轻，羞耻感驱动的回避
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluation and emotional pain
target_behavior.consequence: 支持系统not yet被有效利用、Interpersonal alienation加重
